name: DD Ad Manager – Advertising & Banner Management
author: whitedd

sections.description:
DD Ad Manager is a WordPress advertising plugin for managing direct-sold ads from the WordPress admin.

This WordPress.org plugin is fully functional and includes Campaign, Ad, and Placement management; Display, Before Content, After Content, single In-Text, Shortcode, and Manual placements; Image, HTML/Script, and Video creatives; category and page-type targeting; delivery snapshots; cache controls; and import/export tools.

No functionality contained in this package requires a license, payment, quota, or time-limited access.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through the WordPress admin or extract it into wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate DD Ad Manager.
  3. Open DD Ad Manager in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a Campaign, Placement, and Ad.
  5. Enable delivery in Settings.
sections.faq:
Does changing the admin language change stored data?

No. Language files change display text only. Internal keys, database values, slugs, IDs, hooks, REST namespaces, and event names are not translated.

Does Free send GA4 events?

No. Free does not send DD Ad Manager GA4 impression or click events.

Does uninstall delete data?

Not by default. Data deletion on uninstall is controlled by the plugin Settings screen.

  • Completed Free admin branding alignment to DD Ad Manager.
  • Synchronized all package version metadata at 5.0.17.
  • No frontend ad-delivery behavior changed.

5.0.16

  • Fixed internal package version metadata synchronization.
  • No frontend delivery behavior changed.

5.0.13

  • Hardened REST rate-limit and lock key prefixes for WordPress.org review.
  • Replaced remaining manual nonce verification in admin mutation handlers with WordPress admin nonce checks.
  • Removed commercial-edition promotional UI/text from the Free package metadata.
  • Kept the existing Free delivery, cache, import/export, ad, campaign, and placement workflows available.

5.0.12

  • Clarified that the WordPress.org package is fully functional without license gates or locked commercial functionality.
  • No frontend delivery behavior changed.

5.0.11

  • Hardened plugin-owned SQL table identifiers with WordPress %i prepared placeholders across import/export, repositories, CLI diagnostics, schema validation, and legacy migration paths.
  • Preserved frontend delivery behavior while addressing Plugin Check DirectDB identifier warnings.

5.0.9

  • Removed commercial-only header-anchor placement formats from the WordPress.org package.
  • Removed the obsolete Domain Path header so WordPress.org translations use the standard translation system without a bundled languages directory.
  • Preserved the working Free display, content, single In-Text, Shortcode, Manual, REST, snapshot, and cache delivery paths.

5.0.8

  • Removed commercial-only runtime, schema fields, and controls from the WordPress.org Free package.
  • Kept the Free delivery pipeline, single In-Text placement, cache, category/page-type targeting, and import/export functionality fully available without a license.
  • Removed packaged translation binaries and retained WordPress.org translation compatibility.

5.0.3

  • Migrate legacy banner files and stored URLs from wp-content/ to the WordPress uploads directory.
  • Keep package version metadata synchronized.

5.0.1

  • WordPress.org review compliance update.
  • All functionality shipped in this package is fully enabled without license restrictions.
  • Static and inline assets use WordPress enqueue APIs.
  • Support request processing now verifies a nonce and capability.
  • Banner uploads use the WordPress uploads directory.
  • Bundled runtime translation files removed in favor of WordPress.org language packs.
